Usage:  circleci context restriction create <context-id|context-name> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help           help for create
      --jq string      Process values from the response using jq syntax
      --json           Output as JSON
      --org string     Organization slug (e.g. gh/myorg) or UUID; used when resolving name to ID
      --type string    Restriction type: project, expression, or group
      --value string   Project ID, pipeline expression, or group ID, matching --type
